integrity: All-length proof supplied with a standalone exhaustive and randomized finite checker. These numerical tests do not substitute for the proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Covers ordinary ternary Parikh matrices at composition (2,m,2), not strong equivalence or individual fiber sizes. Possible earlier equivalent fixed-content enumerations remain an historical-priority risk.
title: Exact fixed-content Parikh-matrix image and its parity boundary
